name: ContractorComplianceTracker
tagline: Contractor insurance, licences, inductions and certificates with RAG status and a yes/no gate check – in one Power Apps control.
description: A complete contractor compliance app for facilities and property teams: every contractor document in one register, requirements per company, worker and trade, insurance minimum cover, site inductions with validity, a verify / reject / waive / renew workflow, a contractor × requirement RAG matrix, an expiry timeline with reminders and a site gate check that answers whether a contractor may work today. Runs in canvas apps, model-driven apps and Power Pages.
features: Eligibility to work per contractor and worker (eligible / action needed / not eligible)
Required company, worker and trade-specific documents (low-code settings)
Insurance minimum cover for public, employers' and professional liability
Site-specific inductions with validity in months
RAG compliance matrix with worker rows and add-missing cells
Verify with rules (reference, expiry, cover, evidence, independent verifier), reject with reason, waiver with second approver and time limit
Renewals that keep cover until verified, automatic superseding
Expiry timeline with buckets, renew and reminders
Gate check for contractor, worker, site and date
Generated document requests, renewal reminders and rejection texts (RequestText)
Bulk verify, reminders, export CSV, delete; undo; dated history
Desktop, tablet and phone layouts with bottom bar
Power Fx outputs and events, Dataverse direct save, Power Pages Web API
pack: Niray Real Estate & Facilities PCF Pack
